captions.detailed: A clinical laboratory monocular microscope featuring a solid rectangular base, a vertical support column, and an adjustable stage holding a slide. A monocular eyepiece tube is mounted on a mechanical arm assembly, which is equipped with independent coarse and fine focusing knobs on the side. The focusing carriage slides vertically along the column, the objective turret rotates on its nosepiece axis, the stage moves along a horizontal guide, and both focusing knobs spin continuously on their respective axes.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a clinical monocular microscope with a sturdy base, vertical column, and adjustable specimen stage. The assembly must include a movable focusing carriage with independent coarse and fine focus knobs, a rotating objective turret, and a sliding stage guide, with appropriate metallic, plastic, and glass material finishes.
captions.factory: The model is built using an ArticulatedObject structure. The base is constructed from a rounded box primitive, and the vertical column from a tall rectangular extrusion. The focusing carriage, stage, and nosepiece are modeled using combined boxes and cylinders. Prismatic articulations are defined for the vertical focusing movement of the carriage and the horizontal sliding of the stage, while continuous revolute joints are established for the coarse and fine focus knobs and the objective turret rotation.
